description: Backcountry = multi-night wilderness trips, booked one zone per night. Call with NO query to LIST the backcountry areas. Call with an area/place in `query` PLUS dates and party size to see which zones have room each night (with accessibility surfaced). A trip is then composed one zone per night. start_date/end_date span the nights; pass accessible_only to keep only accessible zones.
name: search_backcountry
title: Search backcountry zones (wilderness permits)
